werust log — notes from the Rust successor

Shipping a Rust renderer, one tier at a time

Posted on 22 July 2026 by the werust team

This is an independently-authored static blog post, generated by a static site generator, so the T1 tier is not tuned to a single exemplar. It exercises the same native path: a real WHATWG parse, a core-CSS cascade, and properly shaped Latin text.

Why tiers?

We climb a pinned ladder. Each rung is driven by real pages and guarded by a WPT bar. As the ladder puts it:

The page checklist defines and drives each tier; the WPT bar measures and guards it.

At this tier we support:

  1. Real headings and paragraphs.
  2. Ordered and unordered lists.
  3. Inline emphasis: italic, bold, and links.

Cost of admission: a properly shaped & cascaded document, rendered by the native path.
